notes: Her title: close on her with the scythe across her shoulders, clouds and the tower's frame far behind her out of focus; the title card -- a dark band, OPERATOR, yellow rules, her name and rarity -- comes and goes over the first second (frames 380-420); crows cross the lens (492-536), the picture breaks up (535-536) and a crow's body blacks it out into the hall (537-542).

Fitted with the camera at the origin on the frames she is seen (380-534: calibration/fit_pose.py, fit_prop.py, the lens the best of a scan of focal lengths, her right hand held to the shaft lightly; the frames crows cover left to the fit's smoothness) and turned with the sky (calibration/sky_rotation.py).  From 481 on she holds still as the picture shows her (the fit there turns her where the crows and the cropped blade leave her pose open); the crows past the lens are fitted to the dark they make of the reference, each flying straight from where it is on its frame (the items' camera_frame).
Its sky's zenith is the blue the reference shows between the clouds (linear, the median of the darker part of the sky).
Its picture shows no building past the crown over her (the skeletal Annex and the district high-rise that Breakout sees east of the tower would stand behind her left shoulder): it leaves them out.

Its clouds stand where the reference shows them, all round the camera: a shell 600-1500 m out about where it stands (Kit.clouds), its share of cloud by direction (calibration/cloud_map.py, frames 380-542) -- laid on a plane, the sky of a camera turning where it stands streaked out where its rays ran low.
Its overlays are keyed frame by frame as the reference draws them (calibration/fit_overlays.py with Operator.overlay_fit.json).
Its look (look.grade) is the tone curve of calibration/fit_look.py on frames [430, 450, 470, 490].
